about.title: Still learning, always building
about.bio: Tenth-semester Systems Engineering student, on track to become a Software Engineer (as of September 2026). I specialize in interactive interfaces with React, Vite, HTML5, and Tailwind CSS, and in designing clean, layered backend architectures based on CQRS patterns. I complement this with relational databases (SQL, Entity Framework), cloud deployment with AWS, and FTP/IIS service infrastructure. I'm passionate about process automation and data analysis with R applied to Business Intelligence.

inkprogress.name: InkProgress Studio
inkprogress.description: Management dashboard for a tattoo studio: appointment scheduling, a smart budget calculator, cash flow tracking, and sprint-based goal tracking. Built to solve a real problem from my own venture.

portfolio.name: This portfolio
portfolio.description: The site you're looking at right now: React + Vite, reusable components, a local translation system, and a contact form connected to a relational database.
